maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from outsourced sterilization, lab testing and Cobalt-60 supply for medical device and pharma customers' products, not servicing installed assets.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private medical device makers, pharmaceutical companies and food processors paying for Sterigenics, Nelson Labs and Nordion services.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth mainly comes from sterilization demand, capacity expansion and testing services across Sterigenics, Nelson Labs and Nordion, with only occasional acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Sterilization and testing are validated and regulator-approved for medical devices, so switching needs re-validation; Nordion supplies Cobalt-60 with few alternatives.
